fullText.simplified:
第十二章、火灾记录

    从太后的宫里出来，包拯马上去找公孙策。宫门口，公孙策正站在夜色里等包拯。
    “怎么样？查到了吗？”包拯快步走过去问。
    “有发现，不过我可不想在这儿说。肚子好饿，先去吃点儿东西，边吃边说！”
    包拯这才发现肚子早就饿得直叫了，他笑道：“好好好，走，我请客！”
    已经是深夜了，外面的饭店早关了门，他们找了几条街也没看到一家亮灯的饭店。没办法，他们回了开封府，自己跑去厨房做了两碗面，就是白水面，放了点儿盐。要是平时，他们肯定会说难吃，但这会儿他们早饿得不行了，吃什么都香。
    “在内班院查到什么了？”包拯边吃边问。
    内班院是宫内的管理和服务部门，宫女和太监的工作都归内班院管，同时还记录宫里发生的各种大事。
    公孙策笑道：“你怎么知道我去内班院了？”
    “就你离开的时候，眼珠转来转去的样子，我还不知道你脑袋里在想什么？”
    “哈哈，果然还是你了解我。”公孙策放下筷子，从衣服里拿出一个小本子说：“李妃生产和冷宫失火的记录都查到了，我记在这个本子里了，你看看。”
    包拯马上接过来仔细看了起来。
    “十一月五日，李妃产子，生狸猫。
    十一月六日，李妃入冷宫。
    十一月七日，冷宫失火，李妃死于火灾。”
    “只有这几句？”包拯疑惑地问。
    “是啊，我也觉得奇怪，但把内班院的记录翻完了，也只找到这三句。不过还是有发现——”公孙策指着小本子下面的一行字说：“你看，这儿有问题。”
    “因灾死亡人数二十三人，含李妃、二十名宫女和两名太监。”
    包拯眼睛一亮，“人数有问题？”
    公孙策点头：“对，从内班院出来，我还去了太医院，看了太医院以前的记录。记录上说，火灾后太医从现场找到二十具尸体，含十九名女子和一名太监。”
    “少了三个人？”包拯吃惊地问。
    “是，和内班院记录的死亡人数相比，少了两名女子和一名太监。”
    “这么大的错误，以前没人发现吗？为什么没有追查？”包拯问。
    公孙策盯着他的眼睛道：“你觉得呢？”
    包拯看着好像已经明白了一切的公孙策，不敢相信但又不得不说道：“如果大火是有人故意放的，那放火的人只要确定他们想杀的人已经死了就可以了，他们不关心一共死了多少人。”
    公孙策点头道：“是的，只要该死的人死了，事情就结束了。他们不在乎死多少人。他们敢在宫里放火，一定是有那个能力，多死几个宫女和太监对他们来说都不是问题。你说，人命在他们心中都不重要了，他们还会在意事后记录的数字吗？”
    包拯沉默了，过了一会儿，他说道：“可能有人发现过数字不对，但只把它当作了数字上的小错误，觉得不值得追查。而如果追查，这可能就是大案，更没有人敢查。”
    公孙策无奈笑道：“也不是所有人都不敢查，还是有不怕死的，开封府的包大人您现在不就在查吗？”
    “死亡的宫女和太监，有没有名单？”包拯问。
    “没有，只有人数，没有名字。”
    “二十多个人，就这样无声地从世界上消失了？”
    “但公道不会消失，因为有你。”公孙策看着包拯道。
fullText.traditional:
第十二章、火災記錄

    從太后的宮裡出來，包拯馬上去找公孫策。宮門口，公孫策正站在夜色裡等包拯。
    “怎麼樣？查到了嗎？”包拯快步走過去問。
    “有發現，不過我可不想在這兒說。肚子好餓，先去吃點兒東西，邊吃邊說！”
    包拯這才發現肚子早就餓得直叫了，他笑道：“好好好，走，我請客！”
    已經是深夜了，外面的飯店早關了門，他們找了幾條街也沒看到一家亮燈的飯店。沒辦法，他們回了開封府，自己跑去廚房做了兩碗麵，就是白水麵，放了點兒鹽。要是平時，他們肯定會說難吃，但這會兒他們早餓得不行了，吃什麼都香。
    “在內班院查到什麼了？”包拯邊吃邊問。
    內班院是宮內的管理和服務部門，宮女和太監的工作都歸內班院管，同時還記錄宮裡發生的各種大事。
    公孫策笑道：“你怎麼知道我去內班院了？”
    “就你離開的時候，眼珠轉來轉去的樣子，我還不知道你腦袋裡在想什麼？”
    “哈哈，果然還是你了解我。”公孫策放下筷子，從衣服裡拿出一個小本子說：“李妃生產和冷宮失火的記錄都查到了，我記在這個本子裡了，你看看。”
    包拯馬上接過來仔細看了起來。
    “十一月五日，李妃產子，生狸貓。
    十一月六日，李妃入冷宮。
    十一月七日，冷宮失火，李妃死於火災。”
    “只有這幾句？”包拯疑惑地問。
    “是啊，我也覺得奇怪，但把內班院的記錄翻完了，也只找到這三句。不過還是有發現——”公孫策指著小本子下面的一行字說：“你看，這兒有問題。”
    “因災死亡人數二十三人，含李妃、二十名宮女和兩名太監。”
    包拯眼睛一亮，“人數有問題？”
    公孫策點頭：“對，從內班院出來，我還去了太醫院，看了太醫院以前的記錄。記錄上說，火災後太醫從現場找到二十具屍體，含十九名女子和一名太監。”
    “少了三個人？”包拯吃驚地問。
    “是，和內班院記錄的死亡人數相比，少了兩名女子和一名太監。”
    “這麼大的錯誤，以前沒人發現嗎？為什麼沒有追查？”包拯問。
    公孫策盯著他的眼睛道：“你覺得呢？”
    包拯看著好像已經明白了一切的公孫策，不敢相信但又不得不說道：“如果大火是有人故意放的，那放火的人只要確定他們想殺的人已經死了就可以了，他們不關心一共死了多少人。”
    公孫策點頭道：“是的，只要該死的人死了，事情就結束了。他們不在乎死多少人。他們敢在宮裡放火，一定是有那個能力，多死幾個宮女和太監對他們來說都不是問題。你說，人命在他們心中都不重要了，他們還會在意事後記錄的數字嗎？”
    包拯沉默了，過了一會兒，他說道：“可能有人發現過數字不對，但只把它當作了數字上的小錯誤，覺得不值得追查。而如果追查，這可能就是大案，更沒有人敢查。”
    公孫策無奈笑道：“也不是所有人都不敢查，還是有不怕死的，開封府的包大人您現在不就在查嗎？”
    “死亡的宮女和太監，有沒有名單？”包拯問。
    “沒有，只有人數，沒有名字。”
    “二十多個人，就這樣無聲地從世界上消失了？”
    “但公道不會消失，因為有你。”公孫策看著包拯道。

sentences.english: Gongsun Ce nodded, “Yes, after leaving the Department of Inner Palace Affairs, ..

sentences.simplified: 我还去了太医院，看了太医院以前的记录。
sentences.traditional: 我還去了太醫院，看了太醫院以前的記錄。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hái qù le tài yī yuàn kàn le tài yī yuàn yǐ qián de jì lù
sentences.english: .. I also went to the Imperial Academy of Medicine and looked at the previous records.

sentences.simplified: 记录上说，火灾后太医从现场找到二十具尸体，含十九名女子和一名太监。”
sentences.traditional: 記錄上說，火災後太醫從現場找到二十具屍體，含十九名女子和一名太監。”
sentences.pinyin: jì lù shang shuō huǒ zāi hòu tài yī cóng xiàn chǎng zhǎo dào èr shí jù shī tǐ hán shí jiǔ míng nǚ zǐ hé yì míng tài jiàn
sentences.english: The records state that after the fire, the imperial physician found twenty bodies at the scene, including nineteen women and one eunuch.”

sentences.simplified: “少了三个人？”包拯吃惊地问。
sentences.traditional: “少了三個人？”包拯吃驚地問。
sentences.pinyin: shǎo le sān ge rén bāo zhěng chī jīng de wèn
sentences.english: “Three people are missing?” Bao Zheng asked in surprise.

sentences.simplified: “是，和内班院记录的死亡人数相比，少了两名女子和一名太监。”
sentences.traditional: “是，和內班院記錄的死亡人數相比，少了兩名女子和一名太監。”
sentences.pinyin: shì hé nèi bān yuàn jì lù de sǐ wáng rén shù xiāng bǐ shǎo le liǎng míng nǚ zǐ hé yì míng tài jiàn
sentences.english: “Yes, compared to the number of deaths recorded by the Department of Inner Palace Affairs, two women and one eunuch are missing.”

sentences.simplified: “这么大的错误，以前没人发现吗？为什么没有追查？”包拯问。
sentences.traditional: “這麼大的錯誤，以前沒人發現嗎？為什麼沒有追查？”包拯問。
sentences.pinyin: zhè me dà de cuò wù yǐ qián méi rén fā xiàn ma wèi shén me méi yǒu zhuī chá bāo zhěng wèn
sentences.english: “Such a big mistake. Didn’t anyone notice it before? Why wasn’t it investigated?” Bao Zheng asked.

sentences.simplified: 公孙策盯着他的眼睛道：“你觉得呢？”
sentences.traditional: 公孫策盯著他的眼睛道：“你覺得呢？”
sentences.pinyin: gōng sūn cè dīng zhe tā de yǎn jing dào nǐ jué de ne
sentences.english: Gongsun Ce stared into his eyes and said, “What do you think?”

sentences.simplified: 包拯看着好像已经明白了一切的公孙策，
sentences.traditional: 包拯看著好像已經明白了一切的公孫策，
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng kàn zhe hǎo xiàng yǐ jīng míng bai le yí qiè de gōng sūn cè
sentences.english: Bao Zheng looked at Gongsun Ce, who seemed to have understood everything.

sentences.simplified: 不敢相信但又不得不说道：
sentences.traditional: 不敢相信但又不得不說道：
sentences.pinyin: bù gǎn xiāng xìn dàn yòu bù dé bù shuō dào
sentences.english: He couldn’t believe it but was compelled to say, ..

sentences.simplified: “如果大火是有人故意放的，那放火的人只要确定他们想杀的人已经死了就可以了，
sentences.traditional: “如果大火是有人故意放的，那放火的人只要確定他們想殺的人已經死了就可以了，
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ dà huǒ shì yǒu rén gù yì fàng de nà fàng huǒ de rén zhǐ yào què dìng tā men xiǎng shā de rén yǐ jīng sǐ le jiù kě yǐ le
sentences.english: .. “If the fire was set deliberately, then the arsonist only needs to ensure that the person they wanted to kill is already dead.

sentences.simplified: 他们不关心一共死了多少人。”
sentences.traditional: 他們不關心一共死了多少人。”
sentences.pinyin: tā men bù guān xīn yí gòng sǐ le duō shao rén
sentences.english: They don’t care how many people died in total.”

sentences.simplified: 公孙策点头道：“是的，只要该死的人死了，事情就结束了。他们不在乎死多少人。
sentences.traditional: 公孫策點頭道：“是的，只要該死的人死了，事情就結束了。他們不在乎死多少人。
sentences.pinyin: gōng sūn cè diǎn tóu dào shì de zhǐ yào gāi sǐ de rén sǐ le shì qing jiù jié shù le tā men bú zài hu sǐ duō shao rén
sentences.english: Gongsun Ce nodded and said, “Yes, as long as the person who needed to die is dead, the matter is over. They don’t care how many people die.

sentences.simplified: 他们敢在宫里放火，一定是有那个能力，
sentences.traditional: 他們敢在宮裡放火，一定是有那個能力，
sentences.pinyin: tā men gǎn zài gōng lǐ fàng huǒ yí dìng shì yǒu nà ge néng lì
sentences.english: They dared to set fire to the palace, so they must have that capability.

sentences.simplified: 多死几个宫女和太监对他们来说都不是问题。
sentences.traditional: 多死幾個宮女和太監對他們來說都不是問題。
sentences.pinyin: duō sǐ jǐ ge gōng nǚ hé tài jiàn duì tā men lái shuō dōu bú shì wèn tí
sentences.english: A few more palace maids and eunuchs dying is not a problem for them.

sentences.simplified: 你说，人命在他们心中都不重要了，他们还会在意事后记录的数字吗？”
sentences.traditional: 你說，人命在他們心中都不重要了，他們還會在意事後記錄的數字嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shuō rén mìng zài tā men xīn zhōng dōu bú zhòng yào le tā men hái huì zài yì shì hòu jì lù de shù zì ma
sentences.english: You see, human lives are not important to them, so would they care about the numbers recorded afterward?”

sentences.simplified: 包拯沉默了，过了一会儿，他说道：“可能有人发现过数字不对，
sentences.traditional: 包拯沉默了，過了一會兒，他說道：“可能有人發現過數字不對，
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng chén mò le guò le yí huì'r tā shuō dào kě néng yǒu rén fā xiàn guò shù zì bú duì
sentences.english: Bao Zheng fell silent. After a while, he said, “Someone might have noticed the numbers were off, ..

sentences.simplified: 但只把它当作了数字上的小错误，觉得不值得追查。
sentences.traditional: 但只把它當作了數字上的小錯誤，覺得不值得追查。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zhǐ bǎ tā dàng zuò le shù zì shang de xiǎo cuò wù jué de bù zhí de zhuī chá
sentences.english: .. but they probably just thought it was a minor error and didn’t think it was worth investigating.

sentences.simplified: 而如果追查，这可能就是大案，更没有人敢查。”
sentences.traditional: 而如果追查，這可能就是大案，更沒有人敢查。”
sentences.pinyin: ér rú guǒ zhuī chá zhè kě néng jiù shì dà àn gèng méi yǒu rén gǎn chá
sentences.english: “And if they did investigate, it could turn into a major case, so no one would dare to investigate.”

sentences.simplified: 公孙策无奈笑道：“也不是所有人都不敢查，还是有不怕死的，
sentences.traditional: 公孫策無奈笑道：“也不是所有人都不敢查，還是有不怕死的，
sentences.pinyin: gōng sūn cè wú nài xiào dào yě bú shì suǒ yǒu rén dōu bù gǎn chá hái shì yǒu bú pà sǐ de
sentences.english: Gongsun Ce said with a helpless smile, “Not everyone is afraid to investigate.

sentences.simplified: 开封府的包大人您现在不就在查吗？”
sentences.traditional: 開封府的包大人您現在不就在查嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: kāi fēng fǔ de bāo dà ren nín xiàn zài bú jiù zài chá ma
sentences.english: There are still those who are not afraid of death. Isn’t Lord Bao of Kaifeng Mansion investigating right now?”

sentences.simplified: “死亡的宫女和太监，有没有名单？”包拯问。
sentences.traditional: “死亡的宮女和太監，有沒有名單？”包拯問。
sentences.pinyin: sǐ wáng de gōng nǚ hé tài jiàn yǒu méi yǒu míng dān bāo zhěng wèn
sentences.english: “Is there a list of the deceased palace maids and eunuchs?” Bao Zheng asked.

sentences.simplified: “没有，只有人数，没有名字。”
sentences.traditional: “沒有，只有人數，沒有名字。”
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu zhǐ yǒu rén shù méi yǒu míng zi
sentences.english: “No, there is only the number of people, not their names.”

sentences.simplified: “二十多个人，就这样无声地从世界上消失了？”
sentences.traditional: “二十多個人，就這樣無聲地從世界上消失了？”
sentences.pinyin: èr shí duō ge rén jiù zhè yàng wú shēng de cóng shì jiè shang xiāo shī le
sentences.english: “More than twenty people just disappeared from the world without a trace?”

sentences.simplified: “但公道不会消失，因为有你。”公孙策看着包拯道。
sentences.traditional: “但公道不會消失，因為有你。”公孫策看著包拯道。
sentences.pinyin: dàn gōng dào bú huì xiāo shī yīn wèi yǒu nǐ gōng sūn cè kàn zhe bāo zhěng dào
sentences.english: “But justice will not disappear, because we have you,” Gongsun Ce said, looking at Bao Zheng.

sentence_translations: Chapter 12: Records of the Fire
After leaving the empress dowager’s palace, Bao Zheng immediately went to find Gongsun Ce.
At the palace gate, Gongsun Ce was standing in the night waiting for Bao Zheng.
“How did it go? Did you find it?” Bao Zheng quickly walked over to ask.
“I did find something, but I don’t want to talk about it here.
I’m really hungry. Let’s get something to eat first and talk while we eat!”
It was only then that Bao Zheng realized his stomach had been growling with hunger for a while.
He laughed and said, “Alright, alright. Let’s go, my treat!”
It was already late at night, and the restaurants outside had long since closed.
They searched several streets but didn’t find a single restaurant with its lights on.
They had no choice but to return to Kaifeng Mansion.
They rushed to the kitchen to make two bowls of noodles, just plain noodles with a little salt.
If it were any other time, they would definitely say it tasted bad, but right now they were so hungry that anything would taste delicious.
“What did you discover at the Department of Inner Palace Affairs?” Bao Zheng ate while asking.
The Department of Inner Palace Affairs is the administrative and service department within the palace.
It oversees the work of the palace maids and eunuchs and also records various major events that occur within the palace.
Gongsun Ce laughed and said, “How did you know I went to the Department of Inner Palace Affairs?”
“Just as you were leaving, your eyes darted around. Do you think I had no idea what was on your mind?”
“Haha, you really do know me well.” Gongsun Ce put down his chopsticks, took out a small notebook from his clothes, and said, ..
.. “I’ve found the records of Consort Li’s childbirth and the fire in the Cold Palace.
I’ve noted them down in this notebook. Take a look.”
Bao Zheng immediately took the notebook and began to examine it carefully.
“On November 5th, Consort Li gave birth to a son, which turned out to be a leopard cat.
On November 6th, Consort Li was sent to the Cold Palace.
On November 7th, a fire broke out in the Cold Palace, and Consort Li perished in the blaze.”
“Is this all there is?” Bao Zheng asked, puzzled.
“Yes, I find it strange too, ..
.. but after going through the records of the Department of Inner Palace Affairs, I only found these three sentences.
But I did discover something––” Gongsun Ce pointed to a line of text at the bottom of the small notebook and said:
“Look, there’s a problem here.”
“The number of deaths due to the fire was twenty-three, including Consort Li, twenty palace maids, and two eunuchs.”
Bao Zheng’s eyes lit up, “Is there an issue with the number of people?”
Gongsun Ce nodded, “Yes, after leaving the Department of Inner Palace Affairs, ..
.. I also went to the Imperial Academy of Medicine and looked at the previous records.
The records state that after the fire, the imperial physician found twenty bodies at the scene, including nineteen women and one eunuch.”
“Three people are missing?” Bao Zheng asked in surprise.
“Yes, compared to the number of deaths recorded by the Department of Inner Palace Affairs, two women and one eunuch are missing.”
“Such a big mistake. Didn’t anyone notice it before? Why wasn’t it investigated?” Bao Zheng asked.
Gongsun Ce stared into his eyes and said, “What do you think?”
Bao Zheng looked at Gongsun Ce, who seemed to have understood everything.
He couldn’t believe it but was compelled to say, ..
.. “If the fire was set deliberately, then the arsonist only needs to ensure that the person they wanted to kill is already dead.
They don’t care how many people died in total.”
Gongsun Ce nodded and said, “Yes, as long as the person who needed to die is dead, the matter is over. They don’t care how many people die.
They dared to set fire to the palace, so they must have that capability.
A few more palace maids and eunuchs dying is not a problem for them.
You see, human lives are not important to them, so would they care about the numbers recorded afterward?”
Bao Zheng fell silent. After a while, he said, “Someone might have noticed the numbers were off, ..
.. but they probably just thought it was a minor error and didn’t think it was worth investigating.
“And if they did investigate, it could turn into a major case, so no one would dare to investigate.”
Gongsun Ce said with a helpless smile, “Not everyone is afraid to investigate.
There are still those who are not afraid of death. Isn’t Lord Bao of Kaifeng Mansion investigating right now?”
“Is there a list of the deceased palace maids and eunuchs?” Bao Zheng asked.
“No, there is only the number of people, not their names.”
“More than twenty people just disappeared from the world without a trace?”
“But justice will not disappear, because we have you,” Gongsun Ce said, looking at Bao Zheng.
